title: androsace americana
intro: Androsace americana, commonly known as Rocky Mountain woolly-bell, is a perennial alpine plant native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the digestive system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Androsace americana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
